API v1 GA

API Reference

REST API — v1 Team plan required for API access

Overview

The PocketRoute API is a RESTful HTTP API that lets you automate route creation, driver assignment, and delivery tracking from your own systems. All requests and responses use JSON. The API is available on Growth (read-only) and Team (full access) plans.

Base URL https://api.pocketroute.io/v1
shell Quick start — list your routes 
curl -s https://api.pocketroute.io/v1/routes \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer pr_live_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"

Authentication

All API requests are authenticated using a Bearer token in the Authorization header. Generate API keys from Settings → Developers → API Keys in your dashboard.

LIVE KEY pr_live_a3f8b2c1d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9
Keep keys secret

API keys carry full account access. Never expose them in client-side code, public repositories, or log files. Use environment variables. If a key is compromised, rotate it immediately from the dashboard.

Keys are prefixed with pr_live_ for production or pr_test_ for the sandbox environment. Test mode routes are not dispatched to real drivers.

Routes

List Routes

GET /v1/routes

Returns a paginated list of routes for your account, ordered by creation date descending.

Query Parameters

Parameter Type Description
status string Filter by status. One of: draft, assigned, dispatched, in_progress, completed, cancelled.
driver_id string Filter routes assigned to a specific driver.
date string ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns routes scheduled for this date.
limit integer Number of results per page. Default: 20. Max: 100.
cursor string Pagination cursor from the previous response's next_cursor field.
shell Example request 
curl -s "https://api.pocketroute.io/v1/routes?status=dispatched&limit=5" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $POCKETROUTE_KEY"
json 200 Response 
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "r_a1b2c3d4e5f6",
      "status": "dispatched",
      "driver_id": "drv_78gh90ij",
      "stop_count": 24,
      "completed_stops": 8,
      "estimated_duration_min": 187,
      "scheduled_date": "2025-06-17",
      "dispatched_at": "2025-06-17T08:32:11Z",
      "created_at": "2025-06-16T22:14:09Z"
    }
  ],
  "has_more": true,
  "next_cursor": "cur_eyJvZmZzZXQiOjV9"
}

Create a Route

POST /v1/routes

Creates a new route. Optionally runs optimization and dispatches to a driver in one call.

Request Body

Field Type Description
stops req array Array of stop objects. Each must include address. Optional: recipient, notes, time_from, time_to, phone.
origin req string Starting address (depot or warehouse).
driver_id string Assign to a driver. Include "dispatch": true to also dispatch immediately.
dispatch boolean If true and driver_id is set, dispatches the route immediately after creation. Default: false.
optimize boolean Run route optimization before saving. Default: true.
scheduled_date string ISO 8601 date for the planned delivery date. Defaults to today.
name string Human-readable name for the route (e.g., "AM Run - Zone 4").
shell Create and dispatch a route 
curl -s -X POST https://api.pocketroute.io/v1/routes \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $POCKETROUTE_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "name": "AM Run - Zone 4",
    "origin": "450 Commerce Blvd, Brooklyn, NY 11207",
    "driver_id": "drv_78gh90ij",
    "dispatch": true,
    "optimize": true,
    "scheduled_date": "2025-06-17",
    "stops": [
      {
        "address": "123 Main St, Brooklyn, NY 11201",
        "recipient": "Sarah Chen",
        "notes": "Leave at door",
        "time_from": "09:00",
        "time_to": "12:00"
      },
      {
        "address": "450 Park Ave, New York, NY 10022",
        "recipient": "James Rivera",
        "phone": "+12125550147",
        "notes": "Buzzer 4B"
      }
    ]
  }'
json 201 Created 
{
  "id": "r_x9y8z7w6v5u4",
  "status": "dispatched",
  "name": "AM Run - Zone 4",
  "driver_id": "drv_78gh90ij",
  "stop_count": 2,
  "optimized": true,
  "estimated_duration_min": 34,
  "estimated_distance_km": 12.4,
  "dispatched_at": "2025-06-17T07:45:00Z",
  "created_at": "2025-06-17T07:44:58Z"
}

Get a Route

GET /v1/routes/:id

Returns full details for a single route, including all stops and their current status.

shell 
curl -s https://api.pocketroute.io/v1/routes/r_a1b2c3d4e5f6 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $POCKETROUTE_KEY"

Update a Route

PATCH /v1/routes/:id

Update route fields. Only draft and assigned routes can be modified. Use this to update the driver, name, or scheduled date. To cancel a dispatched route, set "status": "cancelled".

Drivers

List Drivers

GET /v1/drivers

Returns all drivers on your team with their current availability and active route status.

shell 
curl -s https://api.pocketroute.io/v1/drivers \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $POCKETROUTE_KEY"
json 200 Response 
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "drv_78gh90ij",
      "name": "Marcus Delgado",
      "email": "m.delgado@rapidfleet.co",
      "status": "active",
      "active_route_id": "r_a1b2c3d4e5f6",
      "last_location": {
        "lat": 40.7589,
        "lng": -73.9851,
        "updated_at": "2025-06-17T10:22:43Z"
      }
    }
  ],
  "has_more": false
}

Webhooks

Subscribe to delivery events to get real-time updates sent to your endpoint via HTTP POST. Configure webhook URLs under Settings → Developers → Webhooks.

All events are delivered with a X-PocketRoute-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256) so you can verify authenticity. Retry policy: 3 attempts with exponential backoff over 24 hours.

Available Events

route.created A new route has been created (draft or assigned).
route.dispatched A route has been sent to a driver and they've been notified.
route.started Driver has begun navigating to the first stop.
route.completed All stops have been resolved and the route is marked complete.
stop.completed A single stop was marked as delivered. Payload includes stop ID, timestamp, and optional proof of delivery URL.
stop.failed A stop was marked as failed (no answer, wrong address, refused delivery). Payload includes failure reason.
driver.location_update Driver location changed by more than 100 meters. High frequency — consider filtering client-side. Only available on Team plan.
json Example webhook payload — stop.completed 
{
  "event": "stop.completed",
  "created_at": "2025-06-17T10:14:33Z",
  "data": {
    "stop_id": "stp_1q2w3e4r",
    "route_id": "r_a1b2c3d4e5f6",
    "driver_id": "drv_78gh90ij",
    "recipient": "Sarah Chen",
    "completed_at": "2025-06-17T10:14:31Z",
    "proof_of_delivery_url": "https://cdn.pocketroute.io/pod/img_abc123.jpg"
  }
}

Errors

Errors follow a consistent JSON format with an HTTP status code, machine-readable code, and human-readable message.

HTTP Status Code Meaning
400 invalid_request Missing required fields or invalid field values. Check the details array for per-field errors.
401 unauthorized Missing or invalid API key. Check the Authorization header.
403 forbidden Your plan doesn't include API access, or this resource belongs to a different account.
404 not_found The requested resource doesn't exist or has been deleted.
409 conflict The action can't be completed in the resource's current state (e.g., modifying a completed route).
429 rate_limited Too many requests. Back off and retry after the Retry-After header value (seconds).
500 server_error Something went wrong on our end. We've been alerted. Retry with exponential backoff.

Rate Limits

Rate limits are enforced per API key on a rolling 60-second window.

Growth
120 requests / minute
Team
600 requests / minute
Enterprise
Custom contact us

When rate limited, responses include a Retry-After header with the number of seconds to wait. All rate limit metadata is returned in X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, and X-RateLimit-Reset headers on every response.
